name: lofi
what: Lo-fi production from the two Inner Days demos (docs/demo_study): parts enter and leave instead of building, a tape stop into each break and at the end, a low-pass dip as the only transition into a section, and the bass ducked lightly (the rework keys a limiter on the music from a kick and snare bus; mix.limiter_gate_bus adds it).
section_gains_how: Not applied blind: after the first render read measure_section_levels' contrast and run apply_section_gains with by_role {'scale': x}, aiming from the measured slope (tools/remix_song.py does this).
